## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Vectors
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Geometric vector operations
//  - Integer vectors — concrete bodies
//  - Portable bodies for the numeric tuples

library Vectors
{
    //==
    // # Geometric vector operations
    //
    // The portable reference bodies for Vector2D and Vector3D — magnitude,
    // normalization, the arithmetic operators, dot and cross products, reflection,
    // and transformation by matrix or quaternion. These used to be bodiless
    // intrinsics; the semantics here match System.Numerics Vector2 / Vector3
    // element for element, so a backend may substitute the native call.
    // Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Matrices (row-vector multiplication, v' = v M).
    //
    // Matrix element naming below follows the row-vector layout of
    // `matrices.types.plato`: for Matrix3x2, M11 = Row1.X ... M32 = Row3.Y, and Row3
    // is the translation; for Matrix4x4, M11 = Row1.X ... M44 = Row4.W, and Row4 is
    // the translation.

    //==
    // Vector2D — magnitude and arithmetic

    // The Euclidean length. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Euclidean_vector#Length
    Length(self: Vector2D): Number
        => self.LengthSquared.Sqrt;

    // The squared length: cheaper than Length, and enough for comparisons.
    LengthSquared(self: Vector2D): Number
        => self.X.Square + self.Y.Square;

    // The vector rescaled to unit length. No zero guard: normalizing the zero
    // vector yields NaN components, matching System.Numerics.
    Normalize(self: Vector2D): Vector2D
        => self / self.Length;

    // Component-wise sum.
    Add(left: Vector2D, right: Vector2D): Vector2D
        => (left.X + right.X, left.Y + right.Y);

    // Component-wise difference.
    Subtract(left: Vector2D, right: Vector2D): Vector2D
        => (left.X - right.X, left.Y - right.Y);

    // Uniform scale.
    Multiply(left: Vector2D, scalar: Number): Vector2D
        => (left.X * scalar, left.Y * scalar);

    // Uniform scale with the scalar on the left.
    Multiply(scalar: Number, right: Vector2D): Vector2D
        => (scalar * right.X, scalar * right.Y);

    // Per-axis scale by a pair of factors.
    Multiply(left: Vector2D, factors: Number2): Vector2D
        => (left.X * factors.X, left.Y * factors.Y);

    // Uniform division. Dividing by zero yields infinite or NaN components.
    Divide(left: Vector2D, scalar: Number): Vector2D
        => (left.X / scalar, left.Y / scalar);

    // The vector pointing the opposite way.
    Negative(value: Vector2D): Vector2D
        => (-value.X, -value.Y);

    // The dot product. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dot_product
    Dot(self: Vector2D, right: Vector2D): Number
        => self.X * right.X + self.Y * right.Y;

    // The reflection of the vector off a line with the given normal:
    // v - 2 (v . n) n. Precondition: `normal` is unit length.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reflection_(mathematics)
    Reflect(self: Vector2D, normal: Vector2D): Vector2D
        => self - normal * (2.0 * self.Dot(normal));

    //==
    // Vector2D — transformation

    // Apply a 2D affine map, including the translation row (Row3).
    Transform(self: Vector2D, matrix: Matrix3x2): Vector2D
        => (self.X * matrix.Row1.X + self.Y * matrix.Row2.X + matrix.Row3.X,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.Y + self.Y * matrix.Row2.Y + matrix.Row3.Y);

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): matrix * self.
    Multiply(matrix: Matrix3x2, self: Vector2D): Vector2D
        => self.Transform(matrix);

    // Apply the 2D part of a homogeneous map, including the translation row
    // (Row4): (X M11 + Y M21 + M41, X M12 + Y M22 + M42).
    Transform(self: Vector2D, matrix: Matrix4x4): Vector2D
        => (self.X * matrix.Row1.X + self.Y * matrix.Row2.X + matrix.Row4.X,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.Y + self.Y * matrix.Row2.Y + matrix.Row4.Y);

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): matrix * self.
    Multiply(matrix: Matrix4x4, self: Vector2D): Vector2D
        => self.Transform(matrix);

    // Rotate the vector by a quaternion, treating it as the z = 0 vector and
    // dropping the resulting z. The doubled-component expansion of the sandwich
    // product q v q*. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quaternions_and_spatial_rotation
    Transform(self: Vector2D, rotation: Quaternion): Vector2D {
        var x2 = rotation.X + rotation.X;
        var y2 = rotation.Y + rotation.Y;
        var z2 = rotation.Z + rotation.Z;
        var wz2 = rotation.W * z2;
        var xx2 = rotation.X * x2;
        var xy2 = rotation.X * y2;
        var yy2 = rotation.Y * y2;
        var zz2 = rotation.Z * z2;
        return (self.X * (1.0 - yy2 - zz2) + self.Y * (xy2 - wz2),
                self.X * (xy2 + wz2) + self.Y * (1.0 - xx2 - zz2));
    }

    // Alias for Transform with transform-on-left (* operator): rotation * self.
    Multiply(rotation: Quaternion, self: Vector2D): Vector2D
        => self.Transform(rotation);

    // Apply only the linear part of a 2D affine map: the translation row is
    // skipped, as it must be for displacements and normals.
    TransformNormal(self: Vector2D, matrix: Matrix3x2): Vector2D
        => (self.X * matrix.Row1.X + self.Y * matrix.Row2.X,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.Y + self.Y * matrix.Row2.Y);

    // Apply only the linear part of a homogeneous map.
    TransformNormal(self: Vector2D, matrix: Matrix4x4): Vector2D
        => (self.X * matrix.Row1.X + self.Y * matrix.Row2.X,
            self.X * matrix.Row1.Y + self.Y * matrix.Row2.Y);

    // The combined hash of the components.
    Hash(self: Vector2D): Integer
        => self.X.Hash.CombineHash(self.Y.Hash);

    //==
    // Vector3D — magnitude and arithmetic

    // The Euclidean length. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Euclidean_vector#Length
    Length(self: Vector3D): Number
        => self.LengthSquared.Sqrt;

    // The squared length: cheaper than Length, and enough for comparisons.
    LengthSquared(self: Vector3D): Number
        => self.X.Square + self.Y.Square + self.Z.Square;

    // The vector rescaled to unit length. No zero guard: normalizing the zero
    // vector yields NaN components, matching System.Numerics.
    Normalize(self: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => self / self.Length;

    // Component-wise sum.
    Add(left: Vector3D, right: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => (left.X + right.X, left.Y + right.Y, left.Z + right.Z);

    // Component-wise difference.
    Subtract(left: Vector3D, right: Vector3D): Vector3D
        => (left.X - right.X, left.Y - right.Y, left.Z - right.Z);
```
